title: 第9章 朱火灵果第10章 为什么我没事
slug: 快递通两界我带华夏全民修仙
content_zh:
午时，李婉找了处背风地，停下歇息吃午饭。
打开玉盒一数，里面已然躺着八枚朱火灵果，五八四十贡献点，扣除给花管事的六成，自己还能剩下十六点，算下来收获颇丰。
李婉心中美滋滋的，越发觉得与花管事的交易不亏。
有了这层关系，日后花管事定然还会给自己更多便利，赚取贡献点的速度只会越来越快。
休整片刻，李婉干劲十足，再次动身搜寻。
她沿着冰裂缝一路前行，目光仔细扫视着每一株灵果树苗。
就在她路过一道幽深的冰缝时，眼角余光不经意间向下一瞥，一抹极致绚烂的蓝紫色光芒，骤然映入眼帘。
李婉的脚步猛地顿住，心脏骤然一跳。
那是……
变异朱火灵果！
那株变异朱火灵果长在离地面大概一米左右深的冰裂缝中，透明的枝叶上缠绕着一条拇指大小的蛇，蛇七寸处整齐排列的长着五个淡蓝色的圆环。
蛇头呈三角形，一双阴冷的兽眸，此刻正阴狠警惕的盯着李婉的方向。
这应该就是黄管事所说的变异朱火灵果的伴生妖兽五环蛇了。
李婉对于爬行动物无感，不害怕，但是也提不上喜欢。
面对五环蛇的眼神警告，她表现的无所吊谓，不仅不跑甚至还蹲在了冰原之上思考怎么将蛇引开抢夺变异朱火灵果。
可谓是非常大胆，非常具有初生牛犊不怕虎，天老大她老二的精神了。
一个响亮的响指在寂静的冰原上骤然炸开，清脆的声音惊得五环蛇弓起蛇身，越发警惕的看着上方的人类。
李婉嘴角勾起一抹狡黠的弧度，她想到了。
可以试试火！
从五环蛇身上的颜色一眼就能看出她是冰属性的，冰都怕火，正好她手里有昨天在集市上买的赤焰符。

李婉从怀里无比郑重的掏出装满了待寄特产的袋子，从里面抽出一张赤焰符，又在冰原上捡了一根顺手的长冰棱。
她曲腿蹲在冰裂缝前，一只手做出要采变异朱火灵果的动作，五环蛇吐着蛇信，发出嘶嘶的警告声。
李婉充耳不闻，继续挑衅。
那副吊儿郎当的样子，看得蛇火大。
终于，五环蛇彻底被激怒，它以朱火灵果植株作为着力点，从冰裂缝中蹦出，势要给这个胆大包天的人类一点教训。
就在五环蛇距离李婉有一臂距离的时候，她猛的将赤焰符朝着五环蛇的面中扔去，突如其来的火焰烫得五环蛇发出凄厉的惨叫，为躲避火焰，不得不改变降落点。
趁着无环蛇在空中转向漏出破绽之时，李婉将手中的冰棱狠狠朝着蛇的七寸砸去，五环蛇受到大力的打击，无力的落入深深的冰裂缝。
五环蛇的威胁一解，李婉就以此生最快的速度摘取植株上的变异朱火灵果，然后撒丫子跑出了这片区域。
她才不会留在原地，给五环蛇留下任何报复她的机会。
不过她很怀疑，五环蛇真的能爬出那个深不见底的冰裂缝嘛，从她摘果到逃跑期间，她好像一直都没听到重物着地的声音来着。
不管了。
现在重要的是变异朱火灵果。
李婉看着手里的果子。
变异朱火灵果比普通朱火灵果看着更要晶莹剔透些，比拳头还大，蓝中透紫，像是藏于宇宙中的美丽行星。
长得不像果子，倒是像一件美丽的艺术品。
这么大的朱火灵果可不能再像催生符那样藏在鞋底偷带出去了，放在玉盒里上交李婉肯定是不乐意的，那么眼前的变异朱火灵果只有两个处理方案，要么冒险吃掉，要么和其她东西一起打包寄回老家。
content_en:
At noon, Li Wan found a place leeward and stopped to have lunch.
After opening the jade box and counting, there were already eight Crimson Fire Spirit Fruits lying inside. Five, eight, forty contribution points, after deducting 60% of the 60% given to Hua Guanshi, I still had sixteen points left, so I gained a lot.
Li Wan felt happy in her heart, and felt more and more that the deal with Guanshi Hua was worthwhile.
With this relationship, Guanshi Hua will definitely give himself more conveniences in the future, and the speed of earning contribution points will only get faster and faster.
After a short rest, Li Wan was full of energy and set out to search again.
She walked along the ice crevice, scanning each spiritual fruit sapling carefully.
Just as she passed a deep crevice in the ice, she inadvertently glanced down from the corner of her eye, and a brilliant blue-purple light suddenly came into view.
Li Wan's steps suddenly stopped and her heart skipped a beat.
That's...
Mutated Vermilion Fire Spirit Fruit!
The mutant Vermilion Fire Spirit Fruit grows in an ice crevasse about one meter deep from the ground. A snake the size of a thumb is wrapped around its transparent branches and leaves. There are five light blue rings neatly arranged about seven inches away from the snake.
The snake's head was triangular in shape, and a pair of cold animal eyes were staring in Li Wan's direction with vigilance.
This should be the five-ringed snake that is the companion beast of the mutated Vermilion Fire Spirit Fruit that Manager Huang mentioned.
Li Wan has no interest in reptiles and is not afraid of them, but she doesn't really like them either.
Faced with the warning in the eyes of the five-ringed snake, she showed no concern. Not only did she not run away, she even squatted on the ice sheet to think about how to lure the snake away to snatch the mutated Vermilion Fire Spirit Fruit.
It can be said that he is very bold and has the spirit of a newborn calf who is not afraid of tigers.
A loud snap suddenly exploded on the silent ice field, and the clear sound made the five-ringed snake bow its body and look at the humans above with more vigilance.
The corner of Li Wan's mouth raised a sly arc as she thought about it.
You can try the fire!
From the color of the five-ringed snake, it can be seen at a glance that she is of ice nature. Ice is afraid of fire. It just so happens that she has the red flame talisman she bought at the market yesterday.
Li Wan took out a bag full of specialties to be sent from her arms with great solemnity, took out a red flame talisman, and picked up a long ice edge on the ice field.
She squatted in front of the ice crevasse with her legs bent, and made a gesture with one hand to pick the mutated vermilion fire fruit. The five-ringed snake spat out a snake message and hissed a warning sound.
Li Wan turned a deaf ear and continued to provoke.
His careless look made him angry.
Finally, the five-ringed snake was completely irritated. It used the Vermilion Fire Spirit Fruit plant as its focus and jumped out of the ice crevice, intending to teach this daring human a lesson.
Just when the Five-ringed Snake was an arm's length away from Li Wan, she threw the red flame talisman towards the Five-ringed Snake's face. The sudden flames made the Five-ringed Snake scream in agony. In order to avoid the flames, the Five-ringed Snake had to change its landing point.
Taking advantage of the ringless snake to turn in the air and reveal a flaw, Li Wan slammed the ice edge in his hand towards the snake's seven inches. The five-ringed snake was hit hard and fell helplessly into the deep ice crevice.
As soon as the threat of the five-ringed snake was resolved, Li Wan picked the mutated red fire spirit fruit from the plant as fast as she could in her life, and then ran out of the area.
She would not stay where she was and leave the Five Rings Snake any chance to retaliate against her.
However, she doubted that the five-ringed snake could really crawl out of the bottomless ice crevice. From the time she picked the fruit to the time she escaped, she seemed to have never heard the sound of heavy objects landing.
No matter.
What is important now is the mutated Vermilion Fire Spirit Fruit.
Li Wan looked at the fruit in her hand.
The mutated Vermilion Fire Spirit Fruit looks more crystal clear than the ordinary Vermilion Fire Spirit Fruit, bigger than a fist, blue and purple, like a beautiful planet hidden in the universe.
It doesn't look like a fruit, but it looks like a beautiful piece of art.
Such a big Zhuhuo Lingguo can no longer be hidden in the soles of shoes like a fertility charm. It must be handed over to Li Wan in a jade box.If you don't like it, then you have only two solutions to the mutated Zhuhuo Lingguo in front of you, either take the risk and eat it, or pack it with other things and send it back to your hometown.
